description: This file defines API communication functions for a frontend application to interact with backend endpoints related to authentication and notes management. It includes functions for user login, signup, fetching current user info, and CRUD operations on notes, utilizing fetch with JSON handling, headers, and environment variables.

methods.name: export async function apiFetch<T>( apiFetch
methods.description: A wrapper around fetch that adds base URL, JSON parsing, authorization headers, and error handling.

methods.name: AuthAPI.login
methods.description: Performs login request with email and password, returning user info and token.

methods.name: AuthAPI.signup
methods.description: Performs user signup with name, email, and password, returning user info and token.

methods.name: AuthAPI.me
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's data using a token.

methods.name: NotesAPI.list
methods.description: Retrieves list of notes for the authenticated user.

methods.name: NotesAPI.create
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data.

methods.name: NotesAPI.update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID.

ctags.name: res
ctags.pattern: /^  const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers, cache: "no-store" });$/
